final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry's first line to extract the timestamp, service, level, and message. I converted timestamps to UTC and formatted them as required. I filtered entries to include only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). For each entry, I summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines plus one for the original entry. I collected all such entries in the errors list and also computed counts by service summing the repeat counts. Finally, I wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
